ask: this is a mess fix it
sentence: Splits a restaurant bill by item, lets each person claim their items or share some, adds tax and tip in proportion, and tracks who has paid the person who covered it.
use_when: A group ate together and one person paid, so everyone else needs to pay them back
Each person should pay for what they ordered, with some dishes shared
Tax and tip need to be split in proportion to each person's items
The group wants to see who has paid back and who has not
dont_use_when: The cost should be split equally with no item list
Several people pay different bills and debts need to be netted out over time
The group needs a poll or vote rather than a payment split
